instruction: Set Ask.com as the default search engine for internet queries.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome's default search engine to Ask.com. Uses existing getter 'get_default_search_engine' which reads Chrome preferences file and extracts the default search engine name. Metric 'match_in_list' checks if the result matches 'Ask.com' or 'Ask' (both variants accepted). Postconfig restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted. Same pattern as original task, just different search engine.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'get_default_search_engine' correctly extracts the default search engine name from Chrome preferences file at the appropriate OS-specific path
Metric 'match_in_list' correctly checks if the result matches either 'Ask.com' or 'Ask', accepting both variants as valid
Expected values ['Ask.com', 'Ask'] are semantically correct for the Ask.com search provider
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome (pkill + relaunch + sleep) to ensure preference changes are persisted to disk and fresh state is available for verification
Complete coverage: instruction requires changing default search provider to Ask.com, evaluator verifies exactly that
Proper parameter handling: metric function receives rules dict from get_rule() and correctly accesses rules['expected']
Graceful error handling: getter falls back to 'Google' if preferences file doesn't exist or JSON parsing fails
